title: Large Language Models Discriminate Against Speakers of German Dialects

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through an association task (an adaptation of the Implicit Association Test linking standard vs. dialect German to trait adjectives) and a contextualized decision-making task (assigning speakers to occupations or roles based on stereotypical traits). The study measures both explicit 'dialect naming bias' (explicitly stating a speaker's linguistic background) and implicit 'dialect usage bias' (providing writing samples in standard vs. dialect German).
